decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures like Leovold and Teferi. It utilizes a toolbox strategy with Green Sun's Zenith to find the right creature for any situation. The deck is resilient with cards like Force of Will and swords to Plowshares to deal with threats effectively. Minsc & Boo provide additional value and card advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to provide access to all necessary colors while also including utility lands like Wasteland and Karakas for added disruption.

This deck aims to control the pace of the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Supreme Verdict, the deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up its own resources. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for even more value generation and flexibility in the late game. With a mix of powerful spells and resilient threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath, this deck is designed to outlast and outmaneuver its opponents in a longer, grindy game.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Grief and Murktide Regent. By utilizing cards like Daze and Force of Will, the deck aims to control the game tempo and protect its own threats. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Reanimate and Sheoldred's Edict allows for powerful graveyard interactions and removal options. With a mix of disruptive spells and powerful creatures, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts and aggressive creatures to control the board and quickly defeat the opponent. By using cards like Chalice of the Void to limit the opponent's options, Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble for card advantage, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to bring back important artifacts from the graveyard, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient plays and powerful artifact synergies. The inclusion of counterspells like Force of Will also helps to protect the key pieces of the deck while maintaining tempo.

This Legacy 1 vs 1 Control-Stoneblade deck utilizes a combination of efficient countermagic, removal spells, and powerful equipment to control the game and disrupt opponents. The key concept centers around using Stoneforge Mystic to search for and equip Batterskull or Kaldra Compleat, providing a resilient threat and lifegain. Alongside counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, as well as removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to control the board and protect its threats. Ponder and Brainstorm provide card selection and manipulation, while Teferi, Time Raveler and Snapcaster Mage offer additional utility and versatility.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize control elements, such as counterspells and removal spells, to disrupt your opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage through cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. The inclusion of cards like Back to Basics and Supreme Verdict helps to further control the game and set the pace in your favor. This deck aims to control the board and the game's tempo, ultimately leading to victory through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Esper colors to quickly and efficiently control the board while also establishing a strong tempo advantage through the use of Aether Vial. By combining powerful disruption spells like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will with creatures that provide value like Teferi, Time Raveler and Baleful Strix, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent while simultaneously developing its own board presence. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion gives the deck additional resources and flexibility to outmaneuver opponents in longer games.

The deck focuses on quickly bringing out powerful threats like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's strategies with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze. It also includes plenty of ways to control the board with removal spells like Snuff Out and Dismember, as well as counterspells like Force of Will. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control throughout the game, using a combination of efficient threats and disruptive spells to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to use the cards like Aether Vial, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Lórien Revealed to generate card advantage and play creatures with powerful enter the battlefield effects. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares while simultaneously gaining advantages through cards like Gilded Drake and Recruiter of the Guard. The deck also includes some powerful control elements like Karakas and Plague Engineer to further hinder the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to apply continuous pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan until victory.

This deck aims to quickly cascade into powerful spells using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst while creating a board presence with Crashing Footfalls. By utilizing cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Elvish Spirit Guide, the deck can cast spells ahead of its curve and disrupt opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation. The land base includes fetch lands to ensure smooth mana fixing, with additional removal and card draw options to control the game. This aggressive strategy looks to overwhelm opponents with efficiency and speed.

The deck revolves around the strategy of using "Show and Tell" to cheat powerful permanents like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Omniscience onto the battlefield. It also includes cards like Cunning Wish and Eureka to support the combo. The deck runs various counterspells like Force of Will to protect its key pieces and card selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for necessary combo pieces. Additionally, it includes a mix of other powerful cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Ice-Fang Coatl to provide additional value and utility in different situations.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently through cards like Rite of Flame, Seething Song, and Ruby Medallion, to cast multiple spells in a turn and generate a large storm count for a lethal Galvanic Relay finish. Bonus Round helps duplicate spells for even more storm count, while Jeska's Will provides additional card draw and mana ramp. Burning Wish is used to tutor for specific combo pieces or answers from the sideboard, making the deck versatile and adaptable to different matchups. The key strategy is to generate a high storm count and finish with a massive Grapeshot or Galvanic Relay.

This UWx Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes efficient card draw and selection with Ponder and Brainstorm. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Narset, Parter of Veils and Murktide Regent to close out the game. The main win condition of the deck is to outvalue the opponent through incremental advantage and eventually overwhelm them with a combination of creatures and spells.

The deck revolves around quickly deploying artifacts to generate mana and card advantage, controlling the board with counterspells and removal, while also having a strong aggressive element with creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Kappa Cannoneer. The main win condition is to overwhelm the opponent by quickly assembling a powerful board state with artifacts and efficiently disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Pithing Needle further enhances the deck's ability to control the game and dictate the pace of play.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive play, utilizing early mana acceleration with Lotus Petal, City of Traitors, and Simian Spirit Guide. It uses Chalice of the Void to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect its own. The deck aims to control the board with Archon of Emeria, Solitude, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. It also has a toolbox approach, utilizing Caves of Chaos Adventurer and Seasoned Dungeoneer to find specific answers. The inclusion of Otharri, Suns' Glory adds versatility and resilience. The deck runs a streamlined mana base with a mix of Plains and Mountains for consistency.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by disruption spells like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Wasteland and Lightning Bolt while also maintaining card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble. With a focus on tempo and aggression, this deck looks to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.
